description: This file defines a PHP class 'CalendarViewQuickEdit' which extends the 'SugarView' class and provides functionality for quick editing of calendar entries within the SuiteCRM application. It manages the display of a quick edit form, handles permissions, loads necessary data, and outputs a JSON response with the rendered content.

classes.name: CalendarViewQuickEdit
classes.description: A class extending SugarView that provides quick edit capabilities for calendar entries in SuiteCRM, including permission checks, data loading, and rendering templates.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Initializes the currentBean and checks user permissions for saving, setting the 'editable' flag.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the quick edit form, loads necessary data and templates, and outputs a JSON-encoded response containing the rendered HTML and metadata.
